correctness.rationale: For the exact ternary bracket [x,y,z]=x_3(y_3z_2-y_2z_3)e_2, expanding the weight-zero RB identity on all 27 ordered basis triples gives a complete bottom-row case split. With (a31,a32,a33)=0 all six upper entries are free; with a31!=0 or a31=0,a32!=0 there are two q^3(q-1) and two q^3(q-1)^2 branches. In the final a31=a32=0,a33!=0 branch the relation 2*a22^2*a33=0 forces a22=0 for odd characteristic but not characteristic 2. Totals are q^6+2q^5-q^4-q^3 (odd) and q^6+3q^5-3q^4 (even). Independently enumerated all 2^9 and 3^9 matrices directly from the defining bracket, giving 112 and 1107, with disjoint strata (64,16,16,16) and (729,162,162,54). This symbolically derived case split is valid for all finite fields; the finite tests alone are not its proof.

Earlier Li–Li–Zhang work addresses construction and operators but its accessible summary does not imply these exact field counts.
